status: LOCAL NEW discussion proposal. Unsubmitted, unadopted, not a completed consumable catalog.
scope: A shared actual-use/dose/tolerance/crash/maintenance proposal for finishing all24 source items. It explicitly preserves per-item unknowns instead of claiming that common rules finish their effects.

exactGuideEvidence.exactText: Unless stated otherwise, using a consumable requires an Action, one available hand and access to the actual item. Spend one real unit. Drinking a potion or antitoxin, or feeding one to a willing or Incapacitated living creature within 5 feet, takes an Action. Inability to swallow blocks an oral dose. This gives no free way to dose an unwilling active creature. A potion, poison and healer's kit are not spells.

Preserve Core's existing substance procedures: resolve benefit and crash; a repeat dose before the next long rest requires the substance's dependence CON save; three uses within seven days cause tolerance that halves duration unless doubled; more than two doses before a long rest triggers the substance's severe complication and dependence advancement. This document supplies endpoints, not a replacement substance catalog. Use each item's reviewed dependence DC and severe complication. An item lacking its actual consequence remains in the item review queue rather than gaining an invented generic overdose result.

**Tolerance:** Record doses in a rolling seven-day window. After the third completed dose/use within that window, tolerance becomes active; subsequent uses have half duration unless doubled. The third ordinary use is not retroactively shortened. Count a doubled dose as two doses for tolerance, repeated-dose and overdose accounting; resolve its two-dose thresholds as one consumption event, with at most one dependence save for that event. Seven full days with no dose clears tolerance. One long rest does not clear tolerance. Track each substance separately.

**Maintenance:** At each completed long rest, a new maintenance dose is due for each named dependence. Withdrawal applies immediately until a qualifying dose is taken after that rest; a dose taken before its completion cannot satisfy the new interval. The dose ends that substance's current symptoms until the next maintenance interval but does not remove dependence. Ordinary consumption time, stock, crash, tolerance and repeated-dose rules still apply. No free dose or Action is granted.

**NEW dependence recovery project:** Complete seven consecutive project days without a dose of the named substance. Each day the patient spends one hour in treatment/recovery work and consumes one Supply. Choose Medicine, Religion or Alchemy at project start. At the end of the seventh full day, the designated practitioner (who may be the patient) makes that check against the substance's dependence DC, or NEW DC 14 if a direct Addicted effect supplied no substance DC. Success removes that named Addicted and its associated Withdrawal. Failure removes neither; a new attempt needs a new seven-day project. There is no extra automatic Wound on Critical Failure.

Withdrawal imposes disadvantage on ability checks. “Disadvantage on RP recovery” affects an actual RP recovery roll only; deterministic Retune receives no invented arithmetic penalty. Oracle RC is not RP. The generic Withdrawal condition has no further severity track. An individual substance can add an explicitly reviewed duration or escalation; otherwise do not invent one. Symptom-removal magic does not remove dependence unless it explicitly does, but valid symptom suppression is compatible with completing a no-dose project.

Use one dose-driven score from 0 to 5. Increase it only when an effect explicitly grants Intoxication. A direct effect saying “Intoxicated” supplies a minimum effective score of 2 for its printed duration, or NEW two hours when no duration is supplied. It does not add dose-driven points or count as a dose. Effective score is the greater of the dose-driven score and the active generic floor of 2. Generic timed floors of 3–5 do not exist. A source explicitly setting level 3–5 must individually define its dose-driven change or its own complete recovery exception before becoming operational. Each no-duration floor-2 application expires exactly two elapsed hours after application. Multiple direct floors do not stack, but the floor persists while any is active. Removing one leaves independent points and other direct applications intact.

Quickglass's crash adds1 expedition point and retains its independent one-hour DEX-check disadvantage. Ordinary Wound-treatment Critical Failure adds1 expedition point to the **patient**, without inventing another Wound or Exhaustion level. Morale Rest removes expedition Strain only. Serum Tolerance suppresses the profile side effects it names; it does not prevent serum Strain or its penalties.

**Rest Debt order.** First complete a qualifying safe8hRestWatch and clear debt it satisfies. Then evaluate beneficial Long Rest eligibility. If eligible, apply its sourced benefits, including serum reset and one eligible expedition point when secure. Persistent food/water/source blocks still prevent expedition reduction. An additional safe RestWatch inside the24h reward cap can discharge debt but cannot restore resources, remove expedition Strain, reset the beneficial-rest clock or reset short-rest counts.

**Supply is a basket of real goods:** 2 lb of ration-equivalent edible food, 8 pints of potable water, 1 pint of compatible lamp oil in its flask, and 0.25 lb of ordinary camp sundries. The food and water cover one Small or Medium character's daily demand; Large characters require twice those quantities. This is game accounting. Two pounds of food equal three reviewed Cooking servings; a Large food day is six servings.

At each canonical 24-hour day endpoint, settle each recipient's actual food, water and necessary declared logistics support. A recipient short of any requirement gains **1 expedition Strain total for that day's shortfall**. Missing food and water does not give two Strain. Retain partial consumption credit. The unsupported day blocks Strain removal; that block can clear on a later day only with a real sufficient provisioning plan available and maintained. Crossing a gate does not erase needs: actual Haven/home support pays needs outside the expedition.

Within each permitted reduction plan: formula/bonuses; per-die adjustments; compatible exact fractional multipliers with one floor after multiplication; compatible flat reductions; floor at0; broad HP prohibition; maximum/Critical/reserve caps. Intrinsic Wound Eater and systemic Corrupted remain independent factors. Duplicate same-stat per-die penalties use the strongest. Dice remain dice when maximized/shared; flat Lay on Hands and stored numeric Echoes have zero healing dice.

Blight Totem cannot compound other local healing reducers. Compare systemic factors plus Totem-half alone against systemic factors plus all otherwise compatible local reducers; use the lower result. Compatible halves multiply, compatible distinct flat penalties add, duplicate same-profile groups use strongest. Suppressed reducers do not participate.

**New small-weight completion.** A genuinely small physical source unit lacking weight uses 0.02 lb, except fluid vials, full antitoxin/perfume/basic-poison vials, candles, focus sprigs/totems, holy emblems, sealing wax and soap use 0.1 lb. An ink bottle also uses the small-fluid-container 0.1-lb profile. Narrative background small tokens use the separately stated 0.1-lb accessory profile. Record these as operational estimates, keeping the original source weight null. Larger unweighed items, mounts, vehicles and services do not use this fallback. Do not round away accumulated small items. Coins of every ordinary denomination use fifty coins per pound as a new game-weight convention.

Attacks against unseen targets have disadvantage; unseen attackers have advantage, subject to the **Core Invisible exception**: once its position is known, Invisible's own attack modifiers end for that observer and cannot immediately return solely because it remains Invisible. Independent darkness, smoke, blindness or hiding can still supply modifiers.

| Silenced | Prevents V, command words, Chants and audible coordination. **NEW explicit completion:** includes deliberate ordinary spoken messages. It does not itself forbid thought, reading, writing, signs or a separately valid mental effect. |

Pending effects remain unavailable through this chapter. Their actual review routes are retained in the language interface data; a title, another feature or an external game's version supplies none of their missing rules. The eight compared pending feats likewise remain pending. Quick Learner's thirty-day wording does not replace the course; Polyglot grants no active advantage, Diligent Researcher no active time discount, and unreviewed telepathy no channel.

decisions.title: Separate the two catalogs
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: The twelve magical substances use their printed dependence DC and the Core repeat-dose, tolerance, overdose and crash rules. The twelve brews have no printed dependence DC and do not silently inherit that subsystem. A brew adds Intoxication only when its own proposed operational profile explicitly does so. Preserve Gatehouse Small Beer’s one-serving exemption and Thunder-Vein Ale’s printed delayed +1. Neither an alcohol-like name nor a price creates a generic poisoning, dependence or Intoxication gain. Individual brew proposals must disclose any NEW repeated-serving rule rather than hiding it in this framework.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Confirm the catalog boundary and whether a separate source-directed ordinary brewing rule should give other brews Intoxication; no such increase is adopted here.

decisions.title: Real portions and administration
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: NEW unit proposal: an ordinary brew serving is one actual pint of liquid, provisionally 1 lb plus its real container, drunk over one uninterrupted active minute. A named profile can expressly use a different amount/time. Each magical substance uses one measured ready dose and the existing Action/available-hand/actual-access procedure; oral administration requires actual swallowing and an eligible willing or Incapacitated recipient within 5 ft. Inability to eat as a requirement is not automatically inability to swallow, but no effect supplies missing anatomy. An unwilling active creature receives no generic forced-dose permission. All 24 profiles must specify their actual packaging/mass rather than treating a menu entry as stock. These proposed portions do not replace printed crafting recipe units or transform powders into free inhaled attacks.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Accept or replace the pint/minute brew convention and classify the individual substance units against their actual descriptions. Do not equate the brew serving with a universal meal duration.

decisions.title: Consumption and interruption
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: Reserve actual units when administering. A completed full serving/dose creates one consumption event at its completion timestamp. Fluid/material actually swallowed, spilled or destroyed before an interruption is physically gone; no game benefit is granted for an incomplete dose and no whole unit is refunded. Ordinary consumed water/food counts only when its own source permits that actual amount. Do not combine arbitrary fractional remains into a stronger dose: a named whole-unit preparation procedure must establish usable potency. This is an explicit NEW rule for unfinished administration, not a statement about real chemistry.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Confirm completion timing and distinguish physically lost quantities from completed-dose counters. Individual instant benefits still use their actual completed consumption event.

decisions.title: Dose history belongs to the recipient and named substance
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: Maintain a stable recipient ID and exact substance identity, with completed dose events (eventId, completedAt, units=1 or 2, actual stock IDs), beneficial-long-rest boundaries, dependence status, maintenance interval, tolerance latch, benefit records and crash records. Another supplier, brand, session, controller or inventory transfer does not erase a recipient’s history. Different named substances have separate histories unless an explicit later reviewed equivalence says otherwise. No broad label such as drug, wine, Null or Strain establishes identity.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Confirm the identity and recipient boundaries, including a real later restoration using the same character record; source-specific transformation/restoration exceptions remain controlling.

decisions.title: Rest boundary is an explicit unresolved integration choice
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: NEW proposed resolution: only a genuinely beneficial completed Long Rest resets the doses-since-rest counter and opens the next named-dependence maintenance interval. An extra safe eight-hour Rest Watch inside the reward cap can clear Rest Debt as printed but cannot be used to erase repeat-dose/overdose accounting. Resetting the counter does not clear dependence, tolerance, already scheduled crashes or running effects. This narrows the condition chapter’s unqualified completed-long-rest wording and therefore needs an explicit joint disposition before use; the currently reviewed chapter is not changed by this draft.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Should substance epochs require a beneficial Long Rest, or any actual completed Long Rest? Resolve this against the current safe-Rest-Watch distinction and record an explicit supersession if needed.

decisions.title: Repeat-dose and overdose ordering
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: At a legal completed event, read the recipient’s pre-event tolerance and rest-counter state. One ordinary dose counts as one; a doubled dose counts as two. If this event contains any second-or-later dose since the rest boundary, require one CON save at that named substance’s printed dependence DC, at most one save for the whole event. NEW failure interpretation: become Addicted to that named substance; success never cures existing dependence. If the new rest count exceeds two, also execute that item’s explicit severe complication once for the event and apply the NEW dependence-advancement interpretation: acquire named dependence automatically if absent, otherwise retain it and record the overdose without inventing a second severity scale. The save cannot cancel the separate automatic overdose consequence. Every further event above two triggers its actual complication once, not once per conceptual dose inside a doubled event. A missing complication blocks an item’s operational completion; this draft supplies no generic substitute.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Review the save trigger for a doubled first use, once-per-event overdose, and automatic named dependence as the meaning of advances dependence. Approve each item’s actual severe complication separately.

decisions.title: Tolerance is a latch with exact rolling history
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: Use seven elapsed days = 604800 seconds. The completed-dose counting window is (now−604800, now], so an event exactly seven days old is outside it. At seven full days without a dose, clear the tolerance latch immediately before processing a new dose at that timestamp. If tolerance was inactive before the event, its current ordinary benefit duration is not shortened even when that event reaches three doses in the rolling window. Set tolerance active after that completion if the new rolling count is at least three. Once active it remains active until a full seven-day no-dose interval, even if the rolling count later falls below three while some more recent use remains. A Long Rest does not clear it.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Confirm the exact equality boundary and its order against a simultaneous new dose; the third-use and seven-day abstinence rules come from the reviewed recovery chapter.

decisions.title: What doubling and half duration actually do
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: A doubled event needs two real complete doses already prepared for one actual administration. It uses two units for inventory, rolling tolerance and doses-since-rest, but never doubles potency, temporary HP, damage, number of targets or entitlements. When tolerance was already active, it restores the printed normal benefit duration; without tolerance it gives only that normal duration. One actual Action is permitted only where the individual dose profile allows both ready units to be consumed in that Action; otherwise they are separate completed events, not an after-the-fact doubled declaration. Half duration uses exact elapsed seconds, with no rounding to a larger minute or round. Only duration-based benefits are halved. Crashes, recovery requirements, overdose complications and the duration of an adverse effect are not shortened by generic tolerance. Instant benefits and undefined until-next-rest/one-use endpoints require a named item interpretation; do not invent a half-rest.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Review per-item administration, Dreammilk/Spiral Ink endpoint semantics and Wyrmspice’s missing entitlement duration. No doubling can waive the printed Redwake benefit lock.

decisions.title: Every dose keeps its own ending and crash
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: Create one dose-benefit record with a fixed original endpoint and one pending crash record. Same-name bonuses, advantage and resistance do not stack numerically. A later dose does not erase or postpone an earlier dose’s endpoint or crash. At each dose’s real end, apply its printed crash once even if another dose still supplies a benefit; the two can coexist. NEW proposal: an actual effect-ending cure that removes the benefit early triggers that dose’s crash at the actual ending timestamp unless it explicitly also prevents/removes the crash. Mere suppression pauses neither the original duration nor the crash clock. A spent benefit use ends that entitlement but triggers an immediate crash only where the individual item explicitly binds the crash to that expenditure. Temporary HP follows its actual source record and existing selection rules; there is no pooled duplicate award.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Confirm early ending versus suppression and the intended crash trigger for each consumable. A spell-only dispel does not automatically target a nonspell dose.

decisions.title: One-use rewards cannot become hidden stockpiles
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: NEW proposed policy for a brew or dose saying next/one check or save: overlapping applications of that same item provide at most one available entitlement. A new completed use may refresh that one available opportunity through its own stated expiry, but cannot queue several. Committing the permitted roll marks every currently overlapping same-item entitlement consumed, so an older covered dose does not reappear as another use. Independent named items remain governed by their own scope; advantage sources still do not stack. A future actually paid dose after expenditure can grant a new opportunity, subject to its actual repeat-use costs and risks. Eligibility and commitment occur before the roll, not after seeing failure.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Confirm for Delver’s Bitter, Dragonblood Brandy and Verdant Leaf Wine, or provide explicit alternative bounded entitlements. No use is gained if the item’s timing/eligibility remains undefined.

decisions.title: Condition suppression is not cure or a free maintenance dose
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: Only actual completed consumption satisfies a due maintenance dose. Suppressing Withdrawal symptoms does not remove named dependence, erase the due interval or count as taking a dose. For the proposed beneficial-rest boundary, evaluate actual completed rest, open the new interval, then credit only a completed dose at/after that boundary; a dose from before completion cannot prepay it. A dose legally taken after the boundary may end that substance’s Withdrawal while still causing its own crash, dependence save, tolerance accounting and overdose. The seven-day abstinence recovery project and tolerance clearance can run on the same real calendar, but neither one automatically proves completion of the other’s work/supplies/check. A new dose breaks the abstinence project, even if its benefit was suppressed or redundant.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Review simultaneous completion ordering and whether a completed doubled event can satisfy only the current maintenance requirement, without stockpiling future intervals.

decisions.title: No cross-system cure or resource conversion
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: Keep expedition Strain, Warrior serum Strain, global Exhaustion, dose-driven Intoxication, Unity Exposure, named dependence/Withdrawal, Wounds and HP separate. Quickglass keeps +1 expedition Strain plus its separate one-hour DEX-check disadvantage; neither rest nor suppression silently removes both. A Poisoned immunity does not imply immunity to every substance effect or dependence. Hollow Cask’s eventual −1 healing proposal belongs to the compatible flat-reduction stage and must be compared through Blight Totem’s actual alternate plans, never subtracted twice from one event. A named prohibition on spending RP does not prohibit Oracle RC by name similarity, erase material costs or grant free casts.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Confirm each named interface against its item’s complete profile. The shared chapter must not promote the item solely because a track or healing pipeline already exists.

decisions.title: Physical provisions and economics remain real
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: Keep printed prices and legal labels as source fields, not guaranteed sellers, permission or stock. A bought brew/dose must come from an actual lot and container. Small/Medium normal daily demand is the current two pounds of food and eight pints of water, Large twice, with actual exceptions. Gatehouse Small Beer’s hydration-safe wording supports proposing actual liquid hydration credit, but one serving never creates a whole Supply basket or food ration. Hollow Cask’s hunger suppression does not remove food/water requirements. Deep Blue’s doubled-water crash needs a defined time-weighted or day-end procedure before it becomes operational; no food/oil/camp-sundry doubling is implied. Committing one real basket to an activity does not leave a second inventory basket.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Approve each actual serving’s water/food credit and the Deep Blue partial-day formula. Do not let a purchase price or recipe name decide unreviewed ingredient availability.

decisions.title: Preserve protected-information and source-specific meanings
decisions.classification: NEW local proposed completion or integration; actual GPT disposition pending
decisions.proposal: Current souls/research and planes companions do not mention Ghostwine, Sovereign Reserve or their exact effect phrases in their JSON string values. That bounded finding does not decide those items’ taxonomy, target predicates, observation range, protected facts or terminal recording. Keep their whole source records pending individual conference. Choir Dust’s repeated-use identity-loss phrase and Choirless Absinthe’s named auditory scope likewise cannot be converted into compulsory beliefs, automatic Equation knowledge or a new soul/realm identity. Moonsap’s movement detection must be reconciled with the current known-position Invisible exception; detecting position is not automatically true sight or permission to target through a wall.
decisions.jointReviewQuestion: Resolve these specific item interfaces with actual GPT using the reviewed cosmology sources; do not assume the general cosmology review was also a consumable verdict.
